decision.reason: SOXL is deeply oversold with an RSI near 31 and an extreme 5-day drop of -30.29%, paired with high short volume of 65.7%. This creates a high-conviction tactical mean-reversion opportunity to capture an oversold bounce.
decision.odds_reasoning: Based on historical deeply oversold win rates near 68% for mean reversion setups and the heavy 65.7% short volume providing squeeze potential, adjusted down slightly for the macro headwind of 5.19% yields.
decision.thesis: SOXL has experienced an aggressive capitulation move, dropping -30.29% over the last 5 days to $97.42. With an RSI [a 0-100 gauge of how stretched a price is] of 31.11 and short volume [the share of trading volume made up of short sales] reaching 65.7%, the asset is ripe for a sharp relief bounce. We will buy shares at the current level, targeting a recovery toward $115.00 while risking down to $84.72.
decision.invalidation: The thesis is completely invalidated if the stock breaks decisively below the recent 20-day low of 95.23 with sustained volume, showing that sellers remain completely in control.
decision.plain_english: We are buying shares of SOXL because it has crashed violently over the past five days and is heavily oversold. With so many traders betting against the stock through short selling [borrowing shares to sell them in hopes of buying them back cheaper], any small piece of good news or profit-taking can trigger a sharp upward spike. We will take our profit if it bounces back toward $115, and cut our losses if it drops below $84.72.
